subject: Fellow Intern Candidate Interested in OrthoIQ's Embedded Team
body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I noticed you are a Mechanical Test Intern at OrthoIQ and wanted to reach out, since I just applied for the Embedded Systems & Firmware Engineering Intern role there and would like to hear a bit about what working on the hardware side has been like.

My background is in embedded firmware and hardware, including bare metal microcontroller programming, sensor and motor control on small robotic systems, and building and fabricating my own circuit boards. I am curious how testing and firmware work overlap on your team, since surgical hardware seems like it would need close collaboration between those two sides.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
hook_used: Peer intern at target company, genuine question about team overlap between mechanical test and embedded work
